training.weighting: one observation per completed real GET; query runtimes are not training targets
training.method: request-size-specific GET duration residuals; seeded weighted-CDF sampling; exclude samples with median model timer overshoot above 5 ms; preserve each sparse-tail observation with its measured probability
training.scope: request latency training; partial query coverage does not establish benchmark accuracy
training.startup_policy: exclude first timed real sample per identifiable unprimed process; legacy inputs identify only their initial process
